items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-05-28
items.q: The Kennedy family took care of that.

ctx.x: Well, yeah. Prohibition wasn't exactly a popular law. It was acknowledged in its breach, if you will. And, yeah. The French Quarter was full of liquor. None of it legal, of course. Although I understood if you could get a doctor's prescription, you could always get scotch. The Kennedy family took care of that.
